# EML Attachment Remover 3.0.0

v3 replaces the unsafe v2 text-only conversion with a MIME-pruned working-copy
pipeline. v2.0.1 could alter or omit message content, select a different path through
lexical normalization, lose batch accounting, leave temporary copies after an
interruption, and spend excessive time on message-controlled markup. Retain originals
and regenerate any v2-derived files from those originals.

The v3 output preserves retained original plain and HTML MIME representations in order.
It removes only exact `Content-Disposition: attachment` subtrees and direct non-root
`multipart/related` components, and rejects every weaker or ambiguous role. It does
not claim visually identical rendering, sanitize retained HTML, or fetch resources.
Related references in retained HTML can be unresolved after pruning; mail clients may
show placeholders.

Verify downloaded artifacts before installation:

```sh
shasum -a 256 --check SHA256SUMS
gh attestation verify remove-eml-attachments.pyz --repo resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover
python3.14 remove-eml-attachments.pyz --version
```
